description: This file defines the 'RetrievePolicyStrategy' class, which handles 'RetrievePolicy' commands within the policy retrieval process of the system. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements logic to generate results based on the presence or absence of a Policy entity, as well as determining entity tags for versioning.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the retrieval of policies based on a 'RetrievePolicy' command. It processes the request, creates appropriate result objects, and determines the entity tag for version control.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the core logic to process a 'RetrievePolicy' command, returning either the policy data wrapped in a result or an error if the policy is not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next entity tag for versioning, based on the new policy entity if available.
